primaryChecks.text: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に「men of Tob」と明記される。人々の出身地名への明示的関係を記録する一方、正確な同一地点は留保。

primaryChecks.text: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に「men of Tob」と明記される。人々の出身地名への明示的関係を記録する一方、正確な同一地点は留保。
